description.subject: A crocheted yarn toy figure with a cream-coloured round head, stitched black oval eyes and a curved black mouth, stuffed and standing upright.
description.covering: A crimson hooded jacket with cream scalloped edging, two patch pockets and cream cuffs, worn over cobalt trousers that reach the ankles, with cream trim above mustard-yellow crocheted boots.
description.posture: Standing upright on both boots with the arms held slightly out from the form, the head and form turned toward the viewer.
description.setting: A corner where two plain off-white walls meet a glossy cream tabletop that reflects the toy's lower half.
description.light: Soft, diffuse, even light from the front and left, with gentle shadows and a neutral warm-white colour.
description.anomaly: A single large round yellow plastic fastener with two holes sits at the neck of the jacket, fixed over the cream scalloped front edging.
